name: Bean Spelt Oat Spread
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 250 g mashed beans (white beans or kidney beans)
Seasoning mix (corn flour, salt, chili, onion, garlic, paprika, sodium glutamate) (e.g., Mexican Taco Seasoning Mix)

steps: Take oat flakes, raw spelt, beans and some water and oil for the base substance.
Mash the beans and mix the ingredients.
Add the optional ingredients to taste.
